provenance: Owner-uploaded licensed copies: ASME B31.3-2024 (Table A-1 SI pp.206-315 position-parsed; Table A-3 pp.398-401; Tables 304.1.1-1 and 302.3.5-1 transcribed visually; Appendix H examples H301/H303/H311 as anchors) and ASME BPVC Section IX 2021 (Table QW/QB-422 pp.147-191, Group No assignments; the build cross-checks its P-No column against Table A-1's).
mill_tolerance_note: Owner decision 2026-10-12: effective wall = 0.875 x nominal (12.5% mill tolerance), the convention of Appendix H.
s_column_semantics: Basic allowable stress S in MPa at metal temperature up to and including the column value; interpolate linearly between columns; the last listed column applies to its own temperature only (higher temperatures need the time-dependent rules).

table_304_1_1_y.title: Table 304.1.1-1 Coefficient Y for t < D/6 (SI, deg C)
table_304_1_1_y.temp_semantics: First column covers <=482 deg C; last covers >=677 deg C.
table_304_1_1_y.interpolation: Y may be interpolated for intermediate temperatures.

table_302_3_5_w.title: Table 302.3.5-1 Weld joint strength reduction factor W (SI, deg C)
table_302_3_5_w.temp_semantics: First column covers <=427 deg C. W = 1.0 below the tabulated range of a group (General Note (a)).
table_302_3_5_w.other_materials_note: For other materials: W = 1.0 for Ti <= Tcr, and for SI units W = 1 - 0.00164 * (Ti - Tcr) for Tcr < Ti <= 816 deg C (Note 9). Tcr per General Note (b).
